summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of the new 'Pro Heatmap' feature for ServiceMarket. Covered homeowner navigation via desktop 'More' dropdown, /business-map page (stat cards, leaflet heatmap, list, filters, pagination), claim submission flow, admin Heatmap tab (stats + Approve), Pro user direct navigation + claim, and mobile (390px) bottom-nav 'More' sheet → Pro Heatmap. All critical flows pass with no UI bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: Search field is case/locale-sensitive: searching 'vienna' returns 0 rows because data is stored as 'Wien'. Consider mapping common English city names (Vienna→Wien) or supporting both for UX, since the page header says 'across Austria' in English.
seed_data_creation: Two demo businesses were claimed during testing (one approved by admin, one still pending submitted by pro@test.com). Backend now has 1 claimed / 63 unclaimed / 1 pending.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pro Heatmap feature fully validated. Test artifacts in /app/test_reports/iteration_64.json. All data-testids resolve correctly (business-map-page, business-heatmap, hm-stat-total/cities/claimed, hm-business-list, hm-search-input, hm-category-select, hm-city-select, hm-prev-page/hm-next-page/hm-page-label, business-row-<id>, business-claim-btn-<id>, claim-modal/claim-phone-input/claim-message-input/claim-submit-btn, business-pending-<id>, admin-tab-heatmap, admin-heatmap, hm-admin-total/claimed/unclaimed/pending, csv-import-btn, admin-claim-<id>, claim-approve-<id>, claim-reject-<id>, mobile-nav-more, mobile-nav-more-sheet, mobile-more-business-map). Reject button testid exists but was not clicked during this run because only one pending claim existed and it was approved. CSV import flow not exercised (no test CSV provided).
